name: Cyberpunk 2077
llm3_archetype_notes: Core identity is a street mercenary/outlaw navigating a corrupt world; strong seeker and antihero elements.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
llm3_archetype_notes: Monster hunter with morally gray, hardened disposition; also a capable protector and questing seeker.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
llm3_archetype_notes: Outlaw with violent, morally conflicted arc; warrior and seeker elements emerge through the story.

name: Portal 2
llm3_archetype_notes: Driven by escape and discovery through test chambers; ordinary, resilient outsider with minimal characterization.

name: Hollow Knight
llm3_archetype_notes: A quiet wanderer uncovering the ruins of Hallownest; can be read as small, pure, and heroic but mainly seeker-like.

name: Hades
llm3_archetype_notes: Defies the underworld's order to escape and discover his origins; also a combat-focused hero.

name: Undertale
llm3_archetype_notes: Childlike, open-ended figure moving through a strange world; innocence is central, with seeker and outsider angles.

name: Tomb Raider Game of the Year
llm3_archetype_notes: Archaeological adventurer driven by survival and discovery; also physically heroic and investigative.

name: Half-Life 2
llm3_archetype_notes: Reluctant savior thrust into resistance and survival; more symbol than voiced character.

name: Cuphead
llm3_archetype_notes: Playful, mischievous cartoon outlaw energy dominates more than deep characterization.

name: Portal
llm3_archetype_notes: Minimalist escape-and-discovery arc; ordinary outsider framing with strong player projection.

name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
llm3_archetype_notes: An ordinary blacksmith's son pushed into larger events; growth through hardship and travel.

name: God of War
llm3_archetype_notes: Violent, burdened father-figure antihero whose arc combines combat prowess and protection of his son.

name: Stray
llm3_archetype_notes: A displaced animal navigating an unknown city, emphasizing curiosity, vulnerability, and journeying.

name: Half-Life
llm3_archetype_notes: Reluctant scientist turned action hero; largely defined by survival and movement through disaster.

name: BioShock Infinite
llm3_archetype_notes: Hard-edged, compromised investigator caught in a mystery; seeker and antihero elements dominate.

name: NieR:Automata
llm3_archetype_notes: Ensemble of tragic combatants searching for truth and meaning; identity and transformation are central.

name: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
llm3_archetype_notes: Gentle, childlike spirit with a rescue journey; innocence is primary, with heroic and exploratory traits.

name: Rise of the Tomb Raider
llm3_archetype_notes: Focused on discovery, survival, and archaeological investigation, with strong heroic action framing.

name: Horizon Zero Dawn Complete Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Driven by identity, origins, and uncovering truth in a ruined world; also a skilled protector.

name: Celeste
llm3_archetype_notes: An ordinary, struggling young woman confronting inner obstacles; journey and perseverance are central.

name: Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered
llm3_archetype_notes: Protector-hero balancing personal life and responsibility; strong guardian aspect via Spider-Man identity.

name: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
llm3_archetype_notes: Investigation-driven protagonist with severe personal collapse and moral damage; intellect and self-destruction coexist.

name: Persona 5 Royal
llm3_archetype_notes: Youthful rule-breaker challenging corrupt authority, with transformation via Personas central to the role.

name: Days Gone
llm3_archetype_notes: Wounded survivor with outlaw energy, but grounded in loyalty and endurance.

name: Mafia: Definitive Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: An ordinary man pulled into organized crime, gradually becoming morally compromised.

name: Firewatch
llm3_archetype_notes: An isolated ordinary man seeking escape and answers in the wilderness, with strong introspective focus.

name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Morally gray monster hunter and warrior navigating political intrigue and personal search.

name: Dishonored
llm3_archetype_notes: An accused assassin operating outside the law, with revenge and resistance framing.

name: OMORI
llm3_archetype_notes: Psychologically fraught protagonist split between childlike fantasy and dark self-protective retreat.

name: The Last of Us Part I
llm3_archetype_notes: A damaged survivor whose story centers on protection and morally costly attachment.

name: Shadow of the Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Her journey emphasizes discovery and self-understanding, alongside survival and action.

name: Persona 4 Golden
llm3_archetype_notes: A calm investigator-leader in a mystery-driven coming-of-age story.

name: Yakuza 0
llm3_archetype_notes: Crime-world antiheroes with strong warrior presence; both are bound up with loyalty and power.

name: Katana ZERO
llm3_archetype_notes: Violent, damaged assassin with disorienting wit and defiance.

name: Sleeping Dogs: Definitive Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: An undercover cop balancing duty and immersion in a criminal world; heroic but morally pressured.

name: Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Childlike spirit on a rescue journey; innocence and tenderness are central.

name: Hades II
llm3_archetype_notes: A witch-like underworld combatant associated with ritual and transformation, while still action-heroic.

name: Dishonored 2
llm3_archetype_notes: Leadership and restoration are key for Emily; Corvo reinforces stealthy outsider dynamics.

name: BioShock Remastered
llm3_archetype_notes: An ordinary outsider manipulated into a corrupted world; discovery of truth drives the arc.

name: Max Payne 3
llm3_archetype_notes: Self-destructive hardcase surviving through gunplay and grim persistence.

name: Mafia III: Definitive Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Revenge-driven outsider fighting the system and criminal hierarchy, with strong violent resolve.

name: Mass Effect Legendary Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Leadership is central, with heroic command and galactic discovery/investigation around it.

name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
llm3_archetype_notes: Crime ensemble of morally compromised outlaws, with dark humor and shifting loyalties.

name: FINAL FANTASY XV WINDOWS EDITION
llm3_archetype_notes: A royal heir burdened by duty and leadership, with strong bonds of companionship.

name: Prey
llm3_archetype_notes: Investigative identity mystery on Talos I, with strong search-for-truth structure.

name: CONTROL Ultimate Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Supernatural agency director whose powers and changing reality make transformation central.

name: Alan Wake
llm3_archetype_notes: A writer whose creative work shapes reality and who searches for meaning in a nightmare setting.

name: Spiritfarer: Farewell Edition
llm3_archetype_notes: Nurturing guide helping souls pass on; caretaking is the core of the role.

name: SOMA
llm3_archetype_notes: An ordinary man thrown into existential discovery, with identity and truth-seeking central.
